title: Four-cell contrasts retained a positive source moment in 23 Allen mouse slice groups under an additive model
abstract: We tested whether a positive source-cell variability moment in Allen cortical slices depends on independent source and target effects. We allowed covariance between the two roles of one cell and between reciprocal edge errors. Four-distinct-cell comparison pairs remove both terms from the variance contrast. The mouse source moment was 0.989 squared log-CV units, with a nominal 98.33 percent donor bootstrap interval of 0.170 to 2.183, in 23 groups and 22 inferred mice. The human estimate was -1.124, with an interval of -4.729 to 0.598, in six groups and six donors. Mouse distance-bin and complete-label checks kept positive intervals. The retained-sample correction itself had an uncertain mean change. Only seven mouse and two human groups supported all five component moments. This is a stronger model check on prior data, not an independent replication or a release-mechanism result. Selection, measurement error, inferred donors and sparse human data limit transfer. Original code, aggregate evidence, checks, source hashes and external retrieval instructions support reproduction. Source records remain outside the package.

display.caption: Four-distinct-cell comparisons retained a positive source moment in selected mouse slices. Points and nominal 98.33 percent donor bootstrap intervals use different mouse and human scales. Graph counts show loss of local model support. Data credit: Allen Institute for Brain Science, Synaptic Physiology r2.1; Campagnola, Seeman et al. (2022).

citations.reason: Uses its selection, grouping, donor rules and weighting. Reproduces its point values and tests the positive mouse source moment under a larger covariance model on a smaller retained sample. Same data; no independent replication.
Prior serial-path variability test in the same source data; a different statistic and null.
Exact r2.1 small database; hash and external retrieval recipe preserved.
Pinned field definition inspected through the web tool. No upstream implementation bundled.
Established source, target, generalized reciprocity and dyadic reciprocity random-effects model.
Established identification through independent component matrices.
